subject: 21 St. Clair Road Shelter Proposal
overview: The board conducted a public hearing on a Dover Amendment site plan review application to convert a former convent into a shelter for women and children escaping domestic violence. After extensive public testimony regarding parking, traffic, and educational use criteria, the board voted to continue the hearing to December 4, 2024.

items.title: 21 St. Clair Road Dover Amendment Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued to December 4, 2024, an application by Assisi Holdings LLC to renovate a former convent into Halo House, a proposed educational shelter for women and children. The continuance allows staff and the applicant to resolve the legal status of St. Clair Road, examine parking and sidewalk options, provide legal documentation regarding Dover Amendment applicability, and conduct neighborhood outreach following extensive public comment.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
